blocks: SunSpec chain from 40001, plus a Fronius-proprietary block that has no SunSpec equivalent. Float (11x/21x): common(1) ID@40003 L=65 · inverter(111/112/113) ID@40070 L=60 · nameplate(120) ID@40132 L=26 · settings(121) ID@40160 L=30 · status(122) ID@40192 L=44 · controls(123) ID@40238 L=24 · mppt(160) ID@40264 L=48, always exactly 2 modules · storage(124) ID@40314 L=24, Fronius Hybrid inverters only · End Block ID@40340. Int+SF (10x/20x): each model 10 registers lower. Fronius-proprietary registers, outside the SunSpec chain and below 40001: 212 F_Delete_Data (write 0xFFFF), 213 F_Store_Data (write 0xFFFF), 214 F_Active_State_Code, 215 F_Reset_All_Event_Flags (write 0xFFFF), 216 F_ModelType (1 float / 2 int+SF, write then immediately 6 to acknowledge), 217 F_Storage_Restrictions_View_Mode (0 local default / 1 global), 500-501 F_Site_Power uint32 W, 502-505 F_Site_Energy_Day uint64 Wh, 506-509 F_Site_Energy_Year uint64 Wh, 510-513 F_Site_Energy_Total uint64 Wh. Meter chain on its own device ID: common(1)@40003, meter(211/212/213)@40070 L=124, End Block@40196.

unmappedReports: Everything in the fronius-gen24-sunspec unmapped list that comes from SunSpec models 11x, 120, 121, 122, 123, 160 and 124 applies here unchanged — the offsets inside those models are identical. Only the additions and subtractions are listed below., TmpCab @40110 is marked "Not supported" on this map, along with TmpSnk, TmpTrns and TmpOt. So this dialect reports NO temperature at all. The GEN24 map supports TmpCab. Same register, opposite answer, and the reason `temperature` is absent from this dialect's reports while present on the GEN24 one., Fronius register 214 F_Active_State_Code — the vendor's own active state code, decoded by the per-model CSV tables shipped in the same archive (Primo_State_Codes.csv, Symo_State_Codes.csv). No MetricKind. Marked "not supported for Fronius Hybrid inverters", with the note that inverter status may therefore be reported differently at night., Fronius registers 212 F_Delete_Data, 213 F_Store_Data, 216 F_ModelType, 217 F_Storage_Restrictions_View_Mode — device management writes. 216 in particular reconfigures the entire register map at runtime (float ↔ int+SF), which no CommandKind can express and which no driver should ever send., Fronius register 215 F_Reset_All_Event_Flags — "Write 0xFFFF to reset all event flags and active state code." This is the closest thing in either Modbus dialect to `clear-fault`, and it is NOT the same thing: it clears the reporting, not the condition. Deliberately not claimed as clear-fault., Fronius registers 500 F_Site_Power, 502 F_Site_Energy_Day, 506 F_Site_Energy_Year, 510 F_Site_Energy_Total — site-wide sums across every inverter on the Solar Net ring, at uint32/uint64 width. The contract has no notion of a site aggregate distinct from a device reading, and no device to hang them on. This is the strongest argument in the whole Fronius sweep for a `gateway` DeviceKind reading, the way the Victron GX entry uses one., inverter(11x) WH @40102 carries the vendor note "may be imprecise" — added deliberately in archive changelog 1.1.1-0. ac-energy-total has no way to carry a precision caveat., mppt(160) 1_DCWH / 2_DCWH / DCWH_SF marked not supported for Fronius Hybrid inverters (changelog 1.1.4-0), so pv-energy-total disappears on a Hybrid while remaining present on a non-Hybrid — same dialect, same addresses, different data., String Combiner model 403 and its event flags (LOW_VOLTAGE, LOW_POWER, LOW_EFFICIENCY, CURRENT, VOLTAGE, POWER, PR, DISCONNECTED, FUSE_FAULT, COMBINER_FUSE_FAULT, COMBINER_CABINET_OPEN, TEMP, GROUNDFAULT, REVERSED_POLARITY) — a string combiner has no DeviceKind and its fuse/ground-fault flags have no MetricKind., Sensor Card models — Irradiance model, Back of Module Temperature model, Base Meteorological model. pv-irradiance exists as a MetricKind; back-of-module temperature does not, and the Sensor Card reaches a different device ID (245+) so it is a separate device in contract terms.
